answer: An attester must stake 38% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. Because the echo stake is held until the jetty settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the pulse audit lists each exposure. A farm running 126 keys therefore burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
